Game Overview

In Bunny Needs Carrot, the core idea is straightforward: guide a charming bunny through thrilling levels to gather carrots and access mysterious portals. Experience escalating challenges that test your agility and wit. Overcome cleverly designed obstacles, uncover hidden bonuses, and race against time in this delightful arcade adventure suitable for all ages.
